description: Search the public pages on OnMap.me: local businesses in the United States and unofficial pages for public places (parks, libraries, public offices, museums, stations, landmarks, sports venues). Returns name, kind, city, a one-line summary and the page address. Use get_page for the full facts.

city.description: City or state to narrow to, for example "Dallas" or "TX".

query.description: Words to look for in the name, kind, place or summary, for example "library" or "white rock".

name: search_pages
title: Search pages
